title: A Locker for the Recipe
author: Quentin Blackwood
blurb: Theo Almeida, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
